description: This file defines a custom layout class 'WearableListItemLayout' for a wearable device list item, extending LinearLayout and implementing WearableListView.OnCenterProximityListener to handle focus changes and visual updates.

classes.name: WearableListItemLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout representing an item in a WearableListView, handling visual changes when the item is centered or not.

methods.name: WearableListItemLayout
methods.description: Constructors initializing the layout with context, attributes, and style, and retrieving resource values.

methods.name: onFinishInflate
methods.description: Initializes references to child views after inflation.

methods.name: onCenterPosition
methods.description: Called when the list item is centered; highlights the item visually.

methods.name: onNonCenterPosition
methods.description: Called when the list item is not centered; dims the item visually.
